_note: Difficulty presets (scripts/sim/difficulty.gd). A preset changes only how the AI nations and the crisis generator are tuned, never what the rules give anyone: `ai` and `crisis` are lists of {path, mul}, a dotted path into data/ai.json or data/crises.json and what to multiply that number by. The preset is chosen when a game starts and is saved with it. 'historical' leaves the shipped (trained) numbers alone.

historical.label: Historical
historical.text: The nations play as they were trained, and Europe drifts toward its war as it did.

challenging.label: Challenging
challenging.text: The nations are bolder, take worse odds, keep fighting longer and press their quarrels sooner.

sandbox.label: Sandbox
sandbox.text: The nations are slower to quarrel, wary of long odds and quicker to make peace.
